facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine back to Warwick the smith, in exchange for his lending them the mithril chain shirt.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor, to him; Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral until then.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt over his leather armor (on loan), greatly improving his protection and halving damage from magic weapons and spells.

The Dwarven mine, marked on the treasure map north past the goblin temple ruins, is sealed by a natural-looking cave-in beside a burnt cabin, blocking the metal owed to Warwick. The cave-in can be dug through; Dunk has begun breaking into it.
Warwick believed seven dwarves were working metal in the Dwarven mine, but the mine has caved in and its cabin burned. Is there still metal inside the mine the party can bring out?
